core.title: Paris Single Cylinder Handleset, Schlage JH60PRS

text.description_html:
Schlage JH Series Single Cylinder Paris Handleset

The beautiful scalloped mounts of Schlage's Paris Single Cylinder Handleset are perfect matches to traditional decor. It is a grade 3 entrance door pull and deadbolt. The two-piece design offers flexibility for doors with nonstandard hole locations while providing a subtle classic appearance for entranceways. Universal latch and bolt fits either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches backsets. The Schlage made Paris Handleset is made for door thickness that range from 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches. Available in an array of finishes and with lots of inside trim choices so you'll be sure to find just the right combination to suits your tastes.

When you have a Schlage handleset on your front door, you know your home is secure. Schlage's legendary quality and reliability allow you to focus on other things like selecting just the right finish; and with so many finishes to choose from, you'll be sure to find one that is just right for your home.

Single Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt is thrown or retracted by a key from the outside or by a thumbturn on the inside. The latch is retracted by a thumbpiece from the outside and by a turn knob on the inside.

Features of the Dexter Paris Handleset:

  • ANSI A156.5 Grade 3 Certification.
  • Keying: 5-pin, C keyway with two key
  • 5 year finish warranty.
  • 25 year mechanical warranty.
  • Will fit most standard door preparations.
  • Adjustable throughbolt can move up and down 1-1/2" to fit a variety of pre-existing holes

Specifications of the Schlage Paris Handleset:

  • Rage of Door Preparation: 4" to 5-1/2"
  • Length Center of Bore Hole to Bottom Screw: 8-1/2"
  • Exterior Total Projection: 2-7/16"
  • Backset: Universal latch and bolt fits either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness Range: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"

This handleset is customisable with a huge selection of interior trim knobs and levers and additional finish color options just contact us for all the options!

The inside trim will match the outside handleset's finish.
The LaSalle Lever is not available in Bright Chrome or Satin Stainless Steel.
The Torino Lever is not available in Polished Brass.
The Seville Lever is not available in Polished Brass or Satin Stainless Steel.
The Solstice Lever is not available in Polished Brass or Satin Stainless Steel. .
